decision.rationale: The documented _links array causes an uncaught parser exception and 500. §10.6 identifies a request-shape defect plus failed error handling; unrelated successful-contact statuses do not decide array acceptance.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: ContactsDTO inherits RepresentationModel and the request schema describes _links as an array; the observed parser fails expecting relation names. Documentation’s 200 rows cover successful contact updates, not array parsing. §10.6 and non-gateway 500 establish primary IMPL.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
